rare_event_uncertainty: Bootstrap intervals from sparse or zero observed clusters are not reliable frequency confidence bounds. Publish null plus INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, retain the original interval as a diagnostic only in immutable source books.
frequency_by_asset: Representative asset of each globally clustered event; counts must not be interpreted as independent per-coin shock counts.
usage: Provider-native usage totals with billing uncertainty explicit; peak tariff estimate is never an invoice amount and unknown billing is never zero.
source_status: Use the generated portfolio summary only when its processed origin count matches the coherent SQLite snapshot; otherwise mark summary pending.
